note: openworld/PLAN-SITES.md section 2. A site is one settlement of the scale model (its id in tools/scale-model/model/src/60-settlements.js, on the 5.1 canvas) and its hinterland; a region is the cut that holds one or more sites (tools/scale-model/cut_site.py <region>). reach_km is the half-size of a site's square (city 30, village 15, outpost or camp 8 by default); polygons are regions of the model (by id) that join the cut; corridors are strips width_km wide between two of the region's sites (so the roads between them have ground). state: planned | cut | built.

Wants a bench: the ground round it runs -714 to 4,713 m at a median slope of 169 m/km.

sq11desertw7.name: Esper
sq11desertw7.notes: The Bowl's one farming village, named by the owner 2026-11-24 (the map still reads 'Izani-Dasri village (to be named)': a map edit is queued). An Izani-Dasri village at 895 m: core/hamlet's dasri row with the Iziz Vernacular beside it, as its old label described.

s0zgu7u6yb.name: Solta
s0zgu7u6yb.notes: The Train of Jabal's Bowl salt works by the great salt lake (-1,115 m, the lake 7 km off): rock salt 234 and gypsum 253, 112 km from Jabal by road. Mantis's Izani houses buy their salt here, which is the grievance they carry onto the Catch road (the owner, 2026-11-16: 'Solta too'). model: false until the pin lands; it is held in scale-model batch 5.1e10.

sbabalhawa01.name: Bab al-Hawa
sbabalhawa01.notes: The Vent-Shaft Caravanserai in the Godsgate (biomes/seouterwall/PLAN.md section 3.3): a 40 m Ancient ventilation and access shaft collar sunk 1,400 m to the summit section of the ruined Parabola-Stair bore, plugged 180 m down but still drafting +16 degC air, with the pass's only safe overnight camp in the lee of its cyclopean wind-baffle crescent. About 120 permanent people (the owner, 2026-11-24). KEPT by the owner 2026-11-24 ('Agree keep both'); its pin was moved onto the Godsgate's thalweg at px 1027,1258 (+3,590 m) by the scale-model session's edit 5.1e27, applied 2026-11-25. CORRECTED 2026-11-25: the '1,205 m up the corridor's east wall' this note used to claim of the PIN is the plan's SHAFT pixel 1033,1258 (planned 3,590 m, 5.1 reads 4,795 m); the settlement itself stood 30 m over its own row's thalweg, inside the trench. The shaft pixel still wants moving or benching (openworld/catch-bowl/PLAN-TERRAIN.md P14, P20).

scatchkolli01.name: Kolli
scatchkolli01.notes: 'The cold one', the first water down from the Godsgate at the north fan's toe (1,446 m, 47 mm): a seep, a pool, a reed bed, a well. About 80 people in two compounds, kept by both Iziz merchant houses at one well.

scatcharfwai01.name: Arfwai
scatcharfwai01.notes: 'Halfway', a lined well in a hollow of the reg (1,074 m, 31 mm: the driest of the five): a shaft, a trough, three poplars. About 60 people, the Train of Jabal's hands, by their salt pans. Its well runs down to 30 % in late summer.

svhmyhf33w.name: Salt al-Ban
svhmyhf33w.notes: The Catch's salt works at 458 m on the floor's flattest ground (9 m/km), a pan 11 km off: the Train of Jabal's, worked in the cool months by 100-150 seasonal hands. The map's richest unclaimed evaporites lie within 20 km (halite 239, gypsum 194, potash, soda, saltpeter). model: false until the pin lands; it is held in scale-model batch 5.1e10, and core/region/data/catch-tune.js already declares it.

s2o8f4p123.name: Stair
s2o8f4p123.notes: The crossing's entrepot and the closest thing to a settlement in the Catch: about 750 people in the Hill arcology's ruin at the biggest of the five oases (1,379 m, the spring hollow through the interior hills). The caravan groups' factors and pens, a handful of merchants, the Brotherhood of the Two Horns' guild house, the arcology divers, and the Stair mouths of two Ancient bores (Theodiga south, Parabola north).

scatchbitta01.name: Bitta
scatchbitta01.notes: 'Bitter water', brackish: beasts drink it, people only boiled with ash (1,576 m). About 40 people, kept by whoever holds Stair's pens. A well head, an ash hearth big enough to boil for a caravan, a shelter. Cut by this region and by xanadu-oidong-highrift (reach_km_by).

scatchlasso01.name: Lasso
scatchlasso01.notes: 'The last water' before the Twins and the best on the crossing, 4 km from the perennial Rifar al-Layl (1,509 m). About 100 people in two compounds, Yuni's Merchants' Guild and the Geomancers. Cut by this region and by xanadu-oidong-highrift (reach_km_by).

sttkxo9ndy.name: White Gills Hermitage
sttkxo9ndy.notes: Fifteen History Monks in the White pipe field at 3,746 m, below the live ring fissure (the owner, 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-16). They count the pipes' daily rings for the date of the Cataclysm and pass travellers' news to Longsong; the house doubles as a caravan stop, and the caravans come for saltcup water and lung salt. INSIDE the catch polygon, not the Twins': this region's site. Its buildings are kits/xanadu in the Order's manner; its pipe field waits on biomes/gills.

sz85a8i5js.name: Ranger HQ
sz85a8i5js.notes: Yuni's fortified Stalker-watch at 1,982 m on Lake Vapora's shore, the one habitable spot in 255,000 km2 of Stalker Range, astride the Stalker Gate's four-way pass network. 500 people (the owner, 2026-11-24), on a salary from the Emirate and a small cut of expeditions' profits; it sells escort and Stalker salvage and posts the only standing bounty on Stalkers. The waystation network's anchor. Cut by this region, and shared with whatever region later takes the Stalker Gate's far ends (reach_km_by).

sodpa02bfv.name: Hub 01
sodpa02bfv.notes: A ruined arcology at 4,351 m in a high valley ringed by 12-15 km peaks, run by a mad AI: the Stalkers' source, and the author's secret. NO trail, road or waystation reaches it (the owner, 2026-11-24: 'There is no trail towards hub 01. People who go that way tend not to come back. Foolhardy rangers have brought back reports of an ancient facility there, but its function as stalker HQ is surmised, not confirmed for them'). Drawn as a marker and a far silhouette only; no site plan, no streets, no interior, no approach.
